**ArtfulMelody** | [twitch.tv/artfulmelody](https://www.twitch.tv/artfulmelody)

## The official ArtfulRalph modpack (Fabric 1.20.1)

### Welcome to ArtfulRalph!
A modpack crafted for the creative and adventurous members of the ArtfulMelody community. In this pack, Ralph, the gnome, takes center stage as the source of early-game power, producing magical Glitter that you'll use to craft powerful tools and items as you progress.

But beware, Ralph's sworn enemy, **Geoffrey the Mischievous Giraffe**, roams the fields looking for trouble. While Geoffrey usually keeps to himself, passively wandering the land, he will not hesitate to draw his knife and become dangerous if attacked—or if he spots Ralph nearby!

### What to Expect:
- **Builders & Adventurers:** The world is your canvas! ArtfulRalph brings a colorful and fun environment with plenty of options for those who love to build, explore, and adventure.
- **Tech Enthusiasts:** Dive deep into a variety of tech mods designed to satisfy your love for machines, automation, and all things technology.

Join Ralph and navigate the world filled with machines, Glitter, mischievous giraffes, and endless creativity!

### Artful Additions:

Very special thanks and credits to [Aftermath2502](https://www.curseforge.com/members/aftermath2502) for creating the [Artful Additions mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/artfulmelody-additions)! This was the inspiration for the ArtfulRalph modpack - ArtfulMelody has always wanted a custom mod based on community lore!
